q=math.sqrt
def mm(A,B):return[[sum(A[i][k]*B[k][j]for k in range(len(B)))for j in range(len(B[0]))]for i in range(len(A))]
def dg(A):return[[A[j][i].conjugate()for j in range(len(A))]for i in range(len(A[0]))]
def kr(A,B):return[[A[i//len(B)][j//len(B[0])]*B[i%len(B)][j%len(B[0])]for j in range(len(A[0])*len(B[0]))]for i in range(len(A)*len(B))]
